title: SoftwareOne — claimed by thegentlemen
description: TR · Technology · softwareone.com SoftwareOne Turkiye is the Turkish arm of SoftwareOne Holding AG, a Swiss-listed global software and cloud solutions provider that merged with Crayon to form a 13,000 person company operating in over 70 countries. Based in Ataşehir, Istanbul and active since 2019, it employs around 40 to 60 people and works with 100 percent of Turkey's top 50 companies and 80 percent of the top 500
